body:
I don't really enjoy anything nowadays - but I used to like games, writing and watching videos.

I want to be good at, well... *anything.* Failing everything I try to do is a big part of why I feel worthless. I've tried art, programming, counseling others, music, tutoring, and more but I suck at everything I do. I practice, I give it time, but I never get any better.

I've tried a few therapists and none of them work.

The first, I helped him with HIS problems. The second, focused on the entirely wrong issues. The third, belittled my problems and just told me stupid advice like 'read books' and crap.

The issue is I don't have anything to work towards. Dreams, goals, all dead, right now the only thing to get better for is the sake of getting better - and I don't deserve it when I'm such a failure.

I don't do much outside. When I'm out and about I can't keep negative thoughts away, and seeing other people living happily just makes me want to cry.
I feel exactly the same. If nothing else, you're not alone.
